final_prompt:
Edit this existing approved game foliage atlas into a NEW leaf-only silhouette atlas. The reference image already shows the correct simple oval/almond LEAF SHAPES and flat style: preserve that clean graphic shape language. Do not introduce any botanical realism.
Create a clean precise equal 2 by 2 atlas with FOUR entirely separate clusters on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Draw the clusters ONLY inside these four bounding boxes, given as percentages of the whole square canvas: upper left x=10%..40%, y=10%..40%; upper right x=60%..90%, y=10%..40%; lower left x=10%..40%, y=60%..90%; lower right x=60%..90%, y=60%..90%. EVERYTHING outside these four boxes must have alpha EXACTLY ZERO. All four outer image edges and the large center cross must be completely empty. Do not draw labels or the boxes.
Replace the reference color with FLAT SOLID WHITE. Every leaf interior is uniformly opaque white with no outlines, no vein strokes, no gradients, no noise and no shadows. Keep smooth clean cutout edges. There must be no stray pixels, speckles, brush spray, fuzz, fragments or erase artifacts anywhere.
Upper left: a slender tapered vertical cluster of about 25 overlapping oval leaf blades, staggered left and right.
Upper right: a broad asymmetrical diagonal cluster of about 45 overlapping oval leaf blades with a few small clear gaps.
Lower left: a horizontal band of overlapping oval leaf blades that descends into THREE shorter leaf-only fingers, with no supporting branch.
Lower right: a low wide cluster of small overlapping oval leaf blades.
ONLY leaf blades are allowed. Absolutely no stems, leaf stalks, petioles, connecting lines, branches, vines, tendrils, twigs, flowers or heart-shaped ivy leaves. Individual overlapping leaves alone form each silhouette, like the approved reference. Make the leaf blades moderately broad rather than needle-like. The result is a clean flat graphic opacity mask for a game material to tint; it is not a drawing of a realistic plant. No background checkerboard, no colored matte, no border, no perspective, no lighting, no wall, no text. Preserve real alpha transparency.
